about.lead: AGAPY-GALLERY is a D-VR-360° virtual art gallery where artists exhibit their digital works or enhanced photographs of their handmade works. A whole city dedicated to art, open to all, from any screen.
vision: African art is thriving, yet too often invisible: few galleries, high exhibition costs, and audiences far from cultural venues.
AGAPY-GALLERY turns this around. Instead of asking the public to come to the gallery, we bring the gallery to the public, and give every artist a permanent exhibition space, visible worldwide.
objectives: Build a virtual exhibition gallery for painters, photographers, sculptors and all creators.
Give every artist the chance to exhibit and become known.
Help create a real economy around artists’ works.
Contribute to artists’ income and better living conditions.
Make art and culture accessible to everyone.
Contribute to education and learning through art.
Contribute to the development of our countries.

terms.title: Terms of use and sale
terms.lead: These terms govern the use of AGAPY-GALLERY by visitors, artists and foundations. They follow the rules set out in the project specification.

sections.title: 1. Accounts and access
body: Visiting the city and the galleries requires no account: visitors browse freely.
An account is required only for artists and foundations who wish to exhibit. The holder states their title (Mr, Mrs) or company name.
items: An artist may open several accounts, for example under several pseudonyms, but each account is linked to a unique phone number.
The login is the phone number, preceded by the country code.
The password is 8 to 12 characters long, letters and digits. It can be changed at any time.
Artists can edit all their information at any time from their dashboard.

sections.title: 2. Opening an account
body: Opening a hosting account is a paid service and includes one free publication.
items: Africa: 10,000 F CFA excl. VAT, i.e. 12,000 F CFA incl. VAT (20% VAT).
Rest of the world: $35 excl. VAT.
Payment by bank card or mobile money.

sections.title: 3. Annual renewal
body: On each anniversary date, the account is automatically put on standby: the artist can no longer publish new works.
Reactivation costs 10,000 F CFA excl. VAT in Africa, €30 excl. VAT in Europe and $35 excl. VAT in the rest of the world, every year.

sections.title: 4. Publishing a work
body: Publishing a work requires an active account. The publisher must own the work and provide:
items: the contact details of the artist or foundation;
the name and contact details of their copyright office (for example BURIDA in Côte d’Ivoire).
after: Price per publication: 2,500 F CFA excl. VAT (+ 500 F VAT, i.e. 3,000 F CFA incl. VAT) in Africa, €20 excl. VAT in Europe, $25 excl. VAT in the rest of the world.
Every publication goes through a validation period by the moderation team before going online.

sections.title: 5. Moderation
body: AGAPY-GALLERY ensures that ethical and moral standards are respected.
items: A work deemed scandalous or inappropriate is removed without refund. The artist is placed on a red list and cannot publish for at least 3 months.
Publishing a stolen work leads to the permanent exclusion of its publisher.

sections.title: 6. Free or paid gallery
body: Artists choose whether their gallery is free or paid, and can change this at any time.
Free access may be limited in time, at the artist’s discretion.

sections.title: 7. Visit prices and revenue split
body: A visit to a paid gallery costs 250 F CFA excl. VAT (+ 50 F VAT, i.e. 300 F CFA) in Africa, €1 in Europe and $1.5 in the rest of the world. The 250 F excl. VAT are split as follows:

sections.title: 8. Donations
body: Visitors can support an artist with a donation. 85% of the amount goes to the artist, 15% to AGAPY-GALLERY.

sections.title: 9. Provision account
body: Part of the sums collected is kept in a provision account, traceable artist by artist. It is used to handle any claims from other contributors to a work.

sections.title: 10. Credit account
body: The Credit account (Compte d’Avoir) is an optional prepaid wallet that artists can use to pay for publications and renewals.
It exists from subscription, is inactive by default and can be activated or deactivated at any time.

sections.title: 11. Payouts
body: Sums owed to the artist are paid to their bank account (IBAN) and/or by mobile money, as they choose.

sections.title: Intellectual property
body: The works on display belong to their authors. They are protected by copyright through each artist’s copyright office (for example BURIDA in Côte d’Ivoire). Any reproduction without the author’s consent is prohibited.
All other site content (texts, logo, interface, 3D city) is the property of G’A HOLDING. © G’A HOLDING, all rights reserved.

sections.title: Personal data
body: Personal data is processed in accordance with Ivorian law No. 2013-450 of 19 June 2013 on the protection of personal data, under the supervision of ARTCI (the Côte d’Ivoire Telecommunications/ICT Regulatory Authority).
Only the data needed to run the service is collected. Visitors do not need to create an account.
You have the right to access, correct and delete your data. To exercise it, write to us from the Contact page.

sections.title: Cookies
body: AGAPY-GALLERY only uses technical cookies and storage that the site needs to work: remembering your language and pricing zone.
No advertising or third-party analytics cookies are set.
